facts: GET delegates directly to Better Auth. POST only intercepts update-user.
cookieCache enabled with300-second lifetime. No application plugins configured.
App before/after hooks currently apply account lifecycle checks only to credential sign-in.
Default SDK sessionMiddleware/freshSessionMiddleware may accept signed cache before current DB lookup. freshAge proves age, not revocation.

sensitiveSessionMiddleware requests cache bypass, but getSessionFromCtx merges caller query after its config and short-circuits an existing context session; actual V02 query override bypass was not confirmed.
Current user is selected by immutable session user ID with isActive:true; active nondeleted org, current lock and email verification checked.
Current roles/grants loaded and stale organization mismatch denied. No role-name-only authority.
These are application tenant/permission checks, not a mandatory global policy for public or own-account core auth endpoints.
requireSession repeats current persisted session ID/token/user/expiry mirror check and delegates RBAC.
Fresh-auth assurance tied to current tenant/session and server-owned assurance metadata.
Catch-all custom update-user uses reviewed profile service with current authority, strict input and origin checks; preserve this route.
Permission, optional fresh auth, tenant and optional module gates are separate application action concerns.

recommended_core_boundary: Validate signed cookie authority against current persisted session and current subject before protected core payload or mutation.
Deny missing/expired/revoked session and inactive/permanently locked/future-locked account without private data or unauthorized native writes.
Expired lock is not an active lock; preserve legitimate active account behavior.
Do not derive authority from supplied userId/email/orgId/role names; preserve SDK own-account selection.
Keep existing public auth/recovery/callback/cleanup behavior. Do not introduce tenant/module/role/email-verification requirements across all core own-account endpoints.
authority_policy.failure_behavior: Nullable get-session may return null200 or explicit denial without private fields. Protected resource/action operations deny401/403; unsupported methods retain their source-grounded status. No raw tokens/passwords/cookies in evidence.

operation_selection.policy: Explicit public template allowlist; protected by default for all other operations including unknown future/pathless API operations.
operation_selection.source_binding: node_modules/better-auth/dist/api/to-auth-endpoints.mjs sets hook ctx.path to endpoint.path, preserving :id/:token templates.

source_cautions: Before hooks run before endpoint execution; nested getSessionFromCtx uses the SDK route directly, not outer application hooks. Avoid recursive auth.api.getSession from its own before hook.
If a hook changes query, caller disableCookieCache=false must not override enforced freshness; preexisting ctx.context.session must not retain a stale cache.
Global cookieCache:false alone does not enforce current account lifecycle.
A short preflight query is not transaction-level proof against a simultaneous revocation between admission and mutation; no linearizability claim without explicit race evidence.

graph_evidence.limitation: August2026 graph is discovery-only and lacks this route import edges; live captured source governs all behavior.

repair_summary.current_authority_refresh: Raw getSession() endpoint runs with forced GET/object+headers result, fresh cookie-cache-disabled/refresh-disabled query and discarded cached session context. Store failures propagate; callers cannot convert the fresh lookup to a cache read.
repair_summary.normalization: Only SDK401 CURRENT_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE becomes existing RbacError401 in requireSession; unexpected errors propagate.
repair_summary.excluded_policy: Core own-account admission does not add tenant membership, role, module or verified-email requirements. Existing application guard requirements remain.

correction.reason: getSessionFromCtx catches lookup failures and returns null; optional get-session must distinguish successful anonymous absence from failed authority lookup.
correction.failure_policy: Lookup failures propagate; only a successful empty session lookup retains native get-session null semantics. Native raw lookup headers are forwarded into responseHeaders.
correction.evidence_type: Current source and newly authored unit regression; real runtime fault reproduction not claimed.
